recommended_usage: swallowed with water || take without food
mechanism_of_action: selectively constrains calcium ion influx across cell membranes, leading to vasodilation and a significant reduction in peripheral vascular resistance; prevents excessive constraints in the coronary arteries, thus preventing the risk of strokes and other cardiovascular diseases
side_effects: dizziness || edema || palpitation || drowsiness || nausea || headache || fainting || strong, irregular, rapid heartbeat || frequent or severe chest pain
unsuitable_population: elderly, pregnant women, patients with renal impairment
storage_conditions: store at room temperature between 15°C and 30°C || keep tightly closed
